note: Rockstar Games has not published an official trophy list. Names, descriptions and grades here are those published by Exophase and GTABase, whose lists agree on every entry. PowerPyx's roadmap is the main method source; OutputLag's trophy list, KeenGamer's guide and EGamers' list corroborate the same 55 entries. Guides are written for this entry in its own words and cite their sources; five trophies' exact steps are unconfirmed and say so rather than inventing a method.

trophies.guide: The platinum unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are yours. There is no shortcut: it takes the full road — five story chapters, the 100% checklist, every collectible and activity. Expect around 200 hours at a relaxed pace, difficulty about 4 out of 10, one playthrough, and every trophy is offline. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026).
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: Finish the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the game and cannot be missed — just play through the opening and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.

trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Play through the first chapter's missions in order; the trophy unlocks when the chapter's final mission ends. Story trophies cannot be missed, but there is no mission replay, so play each mission to the end. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.

trophies.guide: Attain 100% Completion — the hardest trophy in the list. The checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) only appears after the story, but everything you do during the story already counts toward it, so do not wait to start. Only five categories need every single item: Robberies, Underwater Discoveries, Shooting Ranges, Drone Races and Bret's Quests. Everything else is lenient: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 50 of 66 weapons, and 70 of the 80 challenges are enough. Budget around 100 hours for this stage, after the 60 to 80 hours of story. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026).

sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are jumps, near misses and other driving feats — they build up naturally as you drive, race and explore. Just keep playing and it will come; there is no need to grind them in one place. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are 9 activity types in the game — sample one of each (races, shooting ranges, fishing, arcade games, drone races and the rest). The game tracks which types you have tried, so work through them as you find them. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Master of None
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each range needs a gold medal, not just a pass. Shooting Ranges are also one of the five categories that must be completed in full for 100%, so this trophy and A Long Road go together. Practise each range until the gold score is in reach. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); Exophase.
trophies.name: The Shootist
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. There are 42 drone races across 14 locations — you need a win at each of the 14 locations, not all 42 races. Drone Races are also one of the five categories that must be completed in full for 100%. Learn each course, then win it. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); Exophase.
trophies.name: Top Fun
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Any race type counts — road, off-road, drone or otherwise — as long as it is a different race each time. Work through the race list and bank a win in 20 of them. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal and take him on in a fishing challenge, then out-fish him. It is a one-off challenge, not a grind. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Walk up to an arcade machine and play one game through to the end. Any arcade game counts. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy is one of the strangers whose mission strand runs through the story. Stranger strands are time-limited: start them early and finish each one before you push far into the story, or the strand can close. Do Andy's missions as soon as they appear. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand is time-limited like the other stranger missions — begin it early and see it through before advancing deep into the story. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand is time-limited — start it as soon as it opens and finish it before you move far into the story. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. There are more than 8 stranger strands in the state, so you do not need every one — but each strand is time-limited, so start them early and finish 8 before the story moves on. The five named finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are a good core. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand is time-limited — begin it early and finish it before you push far into the story. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is time-limited — start it as soon as it appears and see it through before advancing deep into the story. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditation spots in 10 locations, as both Jason and Lucia. This is the single most missable trophy in the game: the meditation spot at Jason's house is only available in Chapter 1, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends, and keep a separate Chapter 1 save as a safety net. Work through the other spots as you explore; each one is a short meditation. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026).
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)
KeenGamer GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap (19 Nov 2026)
trophies.unresolved: Not pinned down yet — no cited guide has confirmed whether the Chapter 1 spot is strictly required for the trophy. PowerPyx earned it after doing the Chapter 1 meditation, so do it to be safe and keep a Chapter 1 save.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are one of the five categories that must be completed in full for 100%, and his strands are time-limited — take Bret's hunts as soon as they open and finish them before the story moves on. The unique animal is the one Bret asks for. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Fair Game
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — collect them and finish any 3 full sets. You do not need every set, just three complete ones. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different spots around Leonida. It builds up as you travel — use it whenever you pass a new location. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in the game; this trophy needs 50 of them, and 100% needs 70. Work through the challenge list as you play — story, activities and exploration all feed it. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and escape until the heat dies down. Do it with your partner present — solo escapes do not count. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Hot Together
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. With your partner, rob a shop, then immediately rob a second and a third — and keep your wanted level the whole time (do not lose the cops between robberies). Plan a route with three shops close together. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or enter new vehicle models and they count as discovered. 100 is well below the 200 of 277 needed for 100%, so this pops naturally as you explore and try different cars, bikes and boats. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Activate Combat Focus in a firefight with several enemies close together and down five before it ends. Pick a busy fight and aim for a cluster. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Take an aircraft at Vice City International Airport and leave by air outside any scheduled flight — steal a plane on the tarmac and take off. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — Rhinos are the game's tanks. This trophy revolves around the Rhino tank; the description's wordplay points to a tank encounter. The cited guides tie this trophy to the Rhino, so get into a Rhino tank situation and it unlocks. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store, stay out of the cameras' and guards' sight, and get in and out without raising the alarm. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection voids the attempt. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.

sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Hit five bank vaults and get away clean each time. Bank vaults are the big robberies — plan each one, then escape before the response closes in. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.

sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Find an armored truck on the road, rob it, then escape the wanted level. Trucks run regular routes — pick a quiet stretch. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
sources: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026)

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit all 52 areas of the state — the map fills in as you go. Drive, fly and walk into every corner; the trophy pops when the last area is discovered. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); Exophase.

trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. There are 9 gangs in Leonida — rob one illegal operation from each of them. Find each gang's operation, hit it, and move on to the next gang. Source: PowerPyx GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap (18 Nov 2026); GTABase GTA 6 trophies.
